meta.title: Hi Scoot | The city moves. Get in the Flow.
meta.description: Rent e-scooters and e-bikes from people in your city, or list yours and earn extra income.

brand.name: Hi Scoot
brand.logoAlt: Hi Scoot logo: Scoot, a dog in sunglasses riding an e-scooter

footer.slogan: The city moves. Get in the Flow.

home.title: The new Hi Scoot website is under construction
home.description: Soon you will be able to rent and list e-scooters and e-bikes here.

designSystem.title: Hi Scoot website building blocks
designSystem.intro: This page shows every building block that repeats across screens, with all its variations. Check each one and switch the language at the top to see the Portuguese text.

colors.title: Colors
colors.description: A single list of colors that every screen follows. Changing a color here changes it across the whole website.

type.title: Typeface
type.description: Inter across the whole website, in four main sizes.
type.sampleBody: Rent an e-scooter near you and pay per day.

icons.title: Official icons
icons.description: The 19 Hi Scoot icons. When one is missing, we use one from the Lucide library.

buttons.title: Buttons
buttons.description: Six button types. Hover and click to see the hover and pressed states.

fields.title: Text fields
fields.description: Normal field, with a hint, with an error and disabled.
fields.emailHint: We will send the confirmation to this email.
fields.priceError: Enter an amount greater than zero.

cards.title: Cards
cards.description: Every content block has four states: loaded, loading, empty and error.
cards.emptyText: Try another neighborhood or change the filters.
cards.errorText: Check your connection and try again.

badges.title: Status labels
badges.description: Show the status of a listing or a booking.

toast.title: Quick notice
toast.description: Shows at the top of the screen for a few seconds and disappears on its own.
toast.errorText: Please try again in a moment.

dialog.title: Confirmation window
dialog.description: Asks for confirmation before an important action. The red button only appears when the action cannot be undone.
dialog.normalText: The Rider will be notified and can make the payment.

header.title: Main menu with language selector
header.description: Always at the top. The PT/EN selector is part of the menu. On mobile, the menu links move to the bottom bar.

bottomNav.title: Bottom bar (mobile)
bottomNav.description: Only on mobile, for logged-in people, fixed to the bottom of the screen.

footer.title: Footer
footer.description: Terms of Use and Privacy Policy links will be added once those texts are ready.

logo.title: Logo
logo.description: The full logo goes in larger spaces, such as the footer. In the top menu, the dog is shown small next to the written name so it stays readable.

errors.emailInvalid: Check your email. It must look like name@example.com.
errors.passwordTooShort: Your password must have at least {min} characters.
errors.invalidCredentials: Incorrect email or password. Check them and try again.
errors.nameTooShort: Your name must have at least {min} letters.
errors.documentRequired: Upload a photo or PDF of this side of the document.
errors.documentType: Format not accepted. Upload JPG, PNG or PDF.
errors.documentTooLarge: File too large. The limit is {max} MB.
errors.termsRequired: To create your account, accept the Terms of Use and the Privacy Policy.

login.title: Log in
login.description: Good to see you again. Log in to rent or list.

signUp.title: Sign up
signUp.description: One account to rent and list e-scooters and e-bikes.
signUp.emailHint: We will send a confirmation link to this email.
signUp.terms: I have read and accept the <terms>Terms of Use</terms> and the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

signUpSuccess.title: Account created. Confirm your email
signUpSuccess.description: We sent a link to your email. Open the message and tap the link to activate your account.
signUpSuccess.spamHint: Not there after a few minutes? Check your spam or junk folder.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.description: We could not complete this action. The link may have expired or already been used. Go back to the start and try again.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot my password
forgotPassword.description: Enter your account email. We will send you a link to create a new password.
forgotPassword.sentDescription: If there is an account with the email {email}, you will receive a link to create a new password.
forgotPassword.sentHint: The link is valid for a short time. Not there? Check your spam folder.

updatePassword.title: Create a new password
updatePassword.description: Choose a new password for your account.

document.label: Photo ID (RG or driver's license)
document.purpose: Upload the front and the back. We will check that the name on the document matches the name you entered.
document.limits: JPG, PNG or PDF, up to {max} MB
document.tipsTitle: For your photo to be approved:
document.tip1: Show the whole document, with all four edges visible.
document.tip2: Avoid glare and shadows. Do not use flash.
document.tip3: Do not cover any part with your fingers.

socialName.title: Trans person whose ID has not been updated yet?
socialName.text: Upload your document as usual. If the name does not match, you can send a photo of a handwritten letter with your chosen name (nome social) and CPF, and our team will review it confidentially.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.placeholder: The official Hi Scoot Terms of Use will be published here before launch.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.placeholder: The official Hi Scoot Privacy Policy, in line with Brazil's LGPD, will be published here before launch.

rejected.title: Upload your document again
rejected.description: The name on the document did not match the name on your account. Upload the front and the back again.
rejected.exampleReason: (Example) The name on the document is different from the name on your account.
rejected.lastAttempt: Please note: this is your last attempt. If the name does not match again, your account will be blocked.

pending.title: Document under review
pending.description: We received the front and back of your document. Our team will check the name and let you know as soon as it is done.

blocked.title: Account blocked
blocked.description: The name on the document did not match your account in two attempts. For security reasons, this account has been blocked.
blocked.canBrowse: You can still browse the website, but you cannot rent or list.

approved.title: Identity verified
approved.description: The name on your document matches your account. You are all set to rent and list.

letter.title: Are you a trans person whose ID does not yet show your chosen name?
letter.description: You can ask us to review the block. Upload a photo of a handwritten letter with:
letter.change: Change the photo of the letter
letter.remove: Remove the photo of the letter
letter.privacy: Only our verification team sees this letter. It is handled confidentially, in line with Brazil's LGPD.
letter.sentDescription: Our team will review your request carefully and confidentially, and let you know as soon as it is done.
